question: Identify the only natural satellite of Earth.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Moon**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Moon:

 
 
• A natural satellite of the Earth is the moon, which we see almost every night.
 
• The moon follows a predictable path around the earth.
 
• Even as the moon revolves around the earth, its orbit is held in place by the gravitational attraction between the earth and the natural satellite.
 
• The surface of the Moon is barren and dusty. 
 
• Various Craters of different shapes and sizes are also found on its surface.
 
• Mitra Crater on Moon is named after Indian radio physicist Sisir Kumar Mitra.
 
• The largest crater on the Moon is called South Pole-Aitken Basin.
 
• Various mountains are also found on the moon which is steep and high, some of which are as lofty as the mountains on the earth. 
 
• The average distance between the Earth and the Moon is 3,84,400 km.​
